<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions where a ketone and an alkyne are broken (lost) and a new C‑C bond is formed, with a C‑O bond broken. This matches the described cycloaddition transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"]
}</action_input>
